excerpt: The page says Phareauditea is "recently released" and "gaining huge hype", but it gives no licence, company or track record.
content:
The page says Phareauditea is "recently released" and "gaining huge hype", but it gives no licence, company or track record. Derivatives trading with an unnamed operator and "huge hype" claims are a common pattern in investment fraud.

What the page says

  • Platform type: internet-based trading platform
  • Technology: AI technology
  • Minimum deposit: min $250
  • Asset class: derivatives
  • Payment methods: credit cards
  • Withdrawal: withdrawal within 24h
  • Registration fee: no sign-up fee
  • Support: continuous support

What we could not check

We have not run regulator or security-database checks on this platform for this review. The page does not name a regulator, licence or company.
